competences.description: Attacks the enemy to inflict damage that ignores the enemy's Defense. Raises the shield to take the [Defense Stance] after attacking.
Attacks all enemies to decrease their Defense for 2 turns. Raises the sword to take the [Offense Stance] after attacking.
Recovers the HP by 100% of the inflicted damage when inflicting damage during the [Offense Stance] and increases the Power of Relic by 10 times upon defeating an enemy. [Automatic Effect]

Decreases the boss' Attack Speed by half and gains immunity against harmful effects and Attack Bar decrease during the [Defense Stance]. If the damage the boss received from the enemy is 5% or lower than the boss' MAX HP, increases the Power of Relic. [Automatic Effect]
